'''Galaxy 9 News''' was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxywide]] news agency that operated during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] and later under the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]]. [[Sella Marik]] was one of the network's reporters.
